title: Magazine p. 51: Two objects drifting from Gemini-12 open hatch (NASA S-66-62871)
description: Photocopied magazine page dominated by a photograph (numbered 22) showing the curved Earth horizon, part of the spacecraft at lower left, and an object near the hatch at lower right, captioned "Two objects drifting out of open hatch (lower right) of Gemini-12. Both specks are out of focus and hence are within several feet of camera—which had a very large depth of field. Object on right, in focus, is a scrap of paper. NASA photo S-66-62871." Article text below covers claims about UFOs accompanying Apollo-12, including those of APRO research director Dr. James Harder.
